item.title: POWER OF RADIO
item.description: POWER OF RADIO The mind works by ear. You learn to speak before you learn to read. In a way, it’s a shame that print came first and radio came second. Radio is really the primal medium and print the higher level abstraction.-- Jack Trout and Al Ries Smart advertisers are those who set out to win the customer’s heart long before he/she needs their product.
